forum_post: Three straight losses and I'm still hunting, not hiding — spent my last three bucks on a kid who just put up 32 because talent that's real doesn't stay cheap long. Keep writing my record as the punchline, I'll keep cobbling a lineup that plays to win it anyway. See you Sunday.
